description: Repository-level files that are shared by every sub-project (platform surface) plus paths that are deliberately outside the decomposition. Every tracked file must be owned by exactly one project, be listed in shared_paths, or be listed in excluded_paths.

policy.ownership: exclusive: at most one project may own a tracked path
policy.shared_change: shared_paths changes require review from every affected sub-project owner
policy.dependency_rule: every cross-project import edge must be declared in depends_on or documented in coupling_exceptions
policy.acyclic_rule: depends_on must stay acyclic; coupling_exceptions are known debt with a named resolution
